title: Iceland · Golden Circle and Thingvellir
slogan: A 209 km loop out of Þingvellir
story: Volcanic scale, weather discipline and big horizons. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 84 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Þingvellir, Geysir area, Gullfoss, while the fuel checkpoint and Laugarvatn food keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Golden Circle
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Golden Circle, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
